units.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies
units.text: 1. Conducting unlawful currency transactions, meaning currency transactions prohibited by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation or conducted in violation of that legislation, including purchasing or selling foreign currency and cheques (including travellers' cheques) denominated in foreign currency without going through authorised banks; or conducting currency transactions settled without using accounts with authorised banks or accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation; or conducting currency transactions settled using funds credited to accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation; or transferring funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation, —

units.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens, persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and legal entities of 20 to 40 per cent of the amount of the unlawful currency transaction or of the funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers; on officials, 20 to 40 per cent of the amount of the unlawful currency transaction or of the funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, but not more than thirty thousand roubles.
